national_questions.qe: Which road in Nagaland was proposed to be declared a National Highway during the meeting with Union Minister Dr. Jitendra Singh?

national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the delegation sought to have the Wokha–Merapani road declared a National Highway.
• Option A is Incorrect; Dimapur–Kohima is already a major highway and was not under discussion.
• Option C is Incorrect; no proposal for Mokokchung–Tuensang was mentioned.
• Option D is Incorrect; Mon–Mokokchung road was not part of the meeting agenda.

national_questions.qe: What was the primary objective of the Memorandum of Arrangement signed between India and Japan in New Delhi in 2024?
national_questions.qh: नयी दिल्ली में 2024 में भारत‑जापान के बीच हस्ताक्षरित समुद्री सुरक्षा सहयोग समझौते का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या था?
oe: To protect Sea Lines of Communication and ensure a free and open Indo‑Pacific
To collaborate on renewable energy projects
oh: संयुक्त अंतरिक्ष मिशनों को बढ़ावा देना
समुद्री मार्गों की सुरक्षा और मुक्त इंडो‑पैसिफिक सुनिश्चित करना
नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा परियोजनाओं पर सहयोग करना
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the MoA signed by Defence Ministers Rajnath Singh and Shinjiro Koizumi specifically aimed at protecting Sea Lines of Communication and maintaining a free, open Indo‑Pacific region. 
• Option A is Incorrect; space cooperation was not mentioned in the MoA. 
• Option C is Incorrect; renewable energy was not a focus of this defence‑level agreement. 
• Option D is Incorrect; cyber‑security exercises were not part of the signed arrangement.

national_questions.qe: Which of the following is a key target of the Delhi Master Plan 2047?
national_questions.qh: दिल्ली मास्टर प्लान 2047 का लक्ष्य वर्ष 2047 तक कौन‑सा है?
oe: Reduce the city's population to 2 crore
Convert all public transport to electric vehicles
oh: शहर की जनसंख्या को 2 करोड़ तक घटाना
सभी सार्वजनिक परिवहन को इलेक्ट्रिक बनाना
30‑40 लाख नए आवासीय फ्लैट प्रदान करना
एक नया अंतर्राष्ट्रीय हवाई अड्डा बनाना
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the plan explicitly envisages adding 30‑40 lakh new residential flats to accommodate the projected population of about 3.2 crore. 
• Option A is Incorrect; the plan does not aim to reduce population. 
• Option B is Incorrect; while promoting public transport, full electrification is not the stated quantitative target. 
• Option D is Incorrect; no new international airport is mentioned in the Master Plan.

national_questions.qe: What is the name of the AI‑enabled voice chatbot launched by DARPG in May 2026?
national_questions.qh: डिपार्टमेंट ऑफ एडमिनिस्ट्रेटिव रिफॉर्म्स एंड पब्लिक ग्रिवेंस (DARPG) द्वारा मई 2026 में लॉन्च किया गया AI‑सक्षम वॉइस चैटबॉट कौन‑सा है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the joint meeting highlighted India's CPGRAMS platform and the AI‑enabled voice chatbot named “Samadhan Didi” launched on 30 May 2026. 
• Option B is Incorrect; no such chatbot was announced. 
• Option C is Incorrect; this name was not used in the meeting.

national_questions.qe: What is the total estimated cost of the four multi-tracking railway projects recently approved by the Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA)?
national_questions.qh: आर्थिक मामलों की मंत्रिमंडलीय समिति (CCEA) द्वारा हाल ही में अनुमोदित चार बहु-ट्रैकिंग रेलवे परियोजनाओं की कुल अनुमानित लागत कितनी है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA), chaired by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, approved four multi-tracking railway projects worth approximately Rs. 9,450 crore, covering eight districts across West Bengal, Odisha, Tamil Nadu, and Andhra Pradesh under the PM-Gati Shakti National Master Plan.
• Option A is Incorrect because ₹7,450 crore is not the allocated figure for these projects.
• Option B is Incorrect because ₹8,500 crore is factually incorrect.
• Option D is Incorrect because ₹11,200 crore does not match the approved financial outlay.

national_questions.qe: In which city was the 2nd BRICS 2026 Tourism Working Group (TWG) meeting hosted under India's Chairship?
national_questions.qh: भारत की अध्यक्षता में दूसरा ब्रिक्स 2026 पर्यटन कार्य समूह (TWG) सम्मेलन किस शहर में आयोजित किया गया था?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the Ministry of Tourism hosted the 2nd BRICS 2026 Tourism Working Group meeting in Jaipur, Rajasthan, under India's BRICS Chairship, focusing on Artificial Intelligence in tourism, sustainability, and skilling under the theme 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability'.
• Option A is Incorrect because the meeting was not held in New Delhi.
• Option C is Incorrect because Bengaluru was not the venue for this meeting.
• Option D is Incorrect because Varanasi did not host this specific working group session.

national_questions.qe: According to the 'Pulse FY2026' report, what percentage of new Universal Account Numbers (UANs) generated belonged to individuals in the 18 to 30 age group?
national_questions.qh: 'पल्स वित्त वर्ष 2026' रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, सृجित नए यूनिवर्सल अकाउंट नंबरों (UAN) में से कितने प्रतिशत 18 से 30 आयु वर्ग के व्यक्तियों के थे?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the 'Pulse FY2026' report highlighted that 79 per cent of new Universal Account Numbers (UANs) generated during 2025-26 belonged to individuals aged 18 to 30 years, with the 21-25 age group alone accounting for over 35 per cent of new accounts entering formal employment.
• Option A is Incorrect because 65 per cent understates the youth employment share.
• Option B is Incorrect because 71 per cent does not match the report findings.
• Option D is Incorrect because 85 per cent is higher than the recorded figure.

national_questions.qe: The Technology Development Board (TDB) provided financial assistance to which startup for the indigenous production of advanced tissue-derived biological dressings?
national_questions.qh: प्रौद्योगिकी विकास बोर्ड (TDB) ने उन्नत ऊतक-व्युत्पन्न जैविक ड्रेसिंग के स्वदेशी उत्पादन के लिए किस स्टार्टअप को वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान की है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the Technology Development Board (TDB) under the Department of Science and Technology provided financial assistance to Gujarat-based startup Orthograft for producing advanced tissue-derived biological dressings for chronic wounds and burns at the Savli Technology Business Incubator in Vadodara.
• Option A is Incorrect as MedTech Solutions Mumbai is not the recipient startup.
• Option C is Incorrect as Aura BioTech Bengaluru is not associated with this DST project.
• Option D is Incorrect as BioHeal Chennai is incorrect.

national_questions.qe: What was India's combined merchandise and services export value during the financial year 2025-26?
national_questions.qh: वित्त वर्ष 2025-26 के दौरान भारत का कुल वस्तु (merchandise) और सेवा निर्यात मूल्य कितना था?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because India's combined merchandise and services exports reached a record US$ 863.1 billion in FY 2025-26, with merchandise exports alone accounting for US$ 441.8 billion, supported by major trade agreements like the India-UAE CEPA.
• Option A is Incorrect because US$ 710.4 billion is lower than the actual record figure.
• Option B is Incorrect because US$ 795.5 billion does not match the official data.
• Option D is Incorrect because US$ 920.8 billion overstates the final export tally.

national_questions.qe: Which ministry organized the two-day PSB Confluence 2026?
national_questions.qh: दो दिवसीय 'PSB कॉन्फ्लुएंस 2026' का आयोजन किस मंत्रालय द्वारा किया गया था?

• Option C is Incorrect because the Ministry of Commerce and Industry did not host this banking confluence.

national_questions.qe: What is the projected market value of India's medical value travel (MVT) industry by the year 2030?
national_questions.qh: वर्ष 2030 तक भारत के चिकित्सा मूल्य यात्रा (MVT) उद्योग का अनुमानित बाजार मूल्य कितना है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because India's medical value travel market, which stood at $8.7 billion in 2025, is projected to scale up to $16.2 billion by 2030, driven by patients from countries like Bangladesh, Iraq, Uzbekistan, Somalia, and Oman seeking treatments and AYUSH therapies.

• Option B is Incorrect because $13.8 billion does not match the official projection.

national_questions.qh: किस संगठन ने उन्नत ऊतक-व्युत्पन्न जैविक ड्रेसिंग के उत्पादन के लिए स्टार्टअप ऑर्थोग्राफ्ट को वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान की है?

national_questions.qe: What is the target completion year for the four railway multi-tracking projects approved by the Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA) with an outlay of Rs 9,450 crore?
national_questions.qh: आर्थिक मामलों की मंत्रिमंडलीय समिति (CCEA) द्वारा 9,450 करोड़ रुपये के परिव्यय के साथ स्वीकृत चार रेलवे मल्टी-ट्रैकिंग परियोजनाओं के पूरा होने का लक्ष्य वर्ष क्या है?
national_questions.e:

• Options A, B, and C are incorrect as they do not align with the official project timeline.

national_questions.qe: What is the expected private equity contribution percentage under the newly proposed Research, Development, and Innovation (RDI) Fund model?
national_questions.qh: नई प्रस्तावित अनुसंधान, विकास और नवाचार (RDI) कोष मॉडल के तहत निजी इक्विटी योगदान का अपेक्षित प्रतिशत क्या है?
national_questions.e:

• Options A, B, and D are incorrect as they do not reflect the 50 percent investment mandate.

national_questions.qe: Which country is India's largest individual FTA export market as of FY 2025-26?
national_questions.qh: वित्तीय वर्ष 2025-26 तक भारत का सबसे बड़ा व्यक्तिगत FTA निर्यात बाजार कौन सा देश है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the India-UAE Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA), operational since May 2022, has established the UAE as India's largest individual FTA export market, with exports reaching US$ 37,359.11 million in FY 2025-26.
• Options B, C, and D are incorrect as they do not hold the status of the largest individual FTA export market for India.

national_questions.qe: Which ministry organized the 'PSB Confluence 2026' where a month-long youth financial integration campaign was announced?
national_questions.qh: किस मंत्रालय ने 'पीएसबी कॉन्फ्लुएंस 2026' का आयोजन किया, जहाँ युवाओं के वित्तीय एकीकरण के लिए एक महीने के अभियान की घोषणा की गई?

Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology

national_questions.qe: The K. Radhakrishnan Committee, recently in the news regarding the National Testing Agency (NTA), was constituted for which primary purpose?

To suggest reforms in the banking sector
To monitor the implementation of digital infrastructure

सार्वजनिक परीक्षा प्रणालियों में आमूलचूल परिवर्तन करने के लिए
डिजिटल बुनियादी ढांचे के कार्यान्वयन की निगरानी के लिए

national_questions.qe: What is the primary objective of the 'Shakti Ki Saptadhara' roadmap adopted by the Ministries of Agriculture and Rural Development?

To enhance agricultural productivity and global export footprint
To provide universal health coverage to farmers
To implement urban infrastructure projects in rural clusters

कृषि उत्पादकता और वैश्विक निर्यात पदचिह्न को बढ़ाना
किसानों को सार्वभौमिक स्वास्थ्य कवरेज प्रदान करना
ग्रामीण समूहों में शहरी बुनियादी ढांचा परियोजनाओं को लागू करना

national_questions.qe: Which ministry organized the 'PSB Confluence 2026' to focus on financial inclusion and youth banking?

oe: Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports
Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology

• Option B is Incorrect as it does not oversee the Department of Financial Services.
• Option D is Incorrect as it focuses on digital infrastructure rather than banking policy.

national_questions.qe: Which agreement emerged as India's largest individual Free Trade Agreement (FTA) export market in FY 2025-26?
national_questions.qh: वित्तीय वर्ष 2025-26 में कौन सा समझौता भारत का सबसे बड़ा व्यक्तिगत मुक्त व्यापार समझौता (FTA) निर्यात बाजार बनकर उभरा है?
national_questions.e:

national_questions.qh: कृषि क्षेत्र के लिए शुरू किए गए 'शक्ति की सप्तधारा' रोडमैप का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य क्या है?

To boost quality, safety, and global market compliance for Indian agriculture

ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में राष्ट्रीय खाद्य सुरक्षा अधिनियम को लागू करना
छोटे किसानों को प्रत्यक्ष नकद हस्तांतरण प्रदान करना

national_questions.e:

national_questions.qh: हाल ही में शुरू की गई कंटेनर विनिर्माण सहायता योजना (CMAS) के लिए कुल वित्तीय परिव्यय क्या है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Container Manufacturing Assistance Scheme (CMAS) was launched with an outlay of ₹10,000 crore to boost India's maritime and logistics capabilities.
• Options A, B, and D are Incorrect as they do not match the official budgetary allocation for this scheme.

national_questions.qe: Which two government bodies signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to enhance the global market presence of India's Geographical Indication (GI) products?
national_questions.qh: भारत के भौगोलिक संकेत (GI) उत्पादों की वैश्विक बाजार उपस्थिति बढ़ाने के लिए किन दो सरकारी निकायों ने समझौता ज्ञापन (MoU) पर हस्ताक्षर किए हैं?
oe: Ministry of Commerce and Ministry of Finance
Ministry of Agriculture and Ministry of External Affairs
NITI Aayog and Ministry of Commerce
national_questions.e:
• Option B is correct because the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT) and the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) signed an MoU on August 5 to accelerate the commercialization and quality enhancement of GI products.
• Other options are incorrect as they do not represent the specific nodal agencies involved in this partnership.

national_questions.qe: Under which specific scheme of the National Green Hydrogen Mission (NGHM) has the 30 Kilo Tonnes Per Annum (KTPA) green hydrogen production capacity been awarded?
national_questions.qh: राष्ट्रीय हरित हाइड्रोजन मिशन (NGHM) की किस विशिष्ट योजना के तहत 30 किलो टन प्रति वर्ष (KTPA) हरित हाइड्रोजन उत्पादन क्षमता प्रदान की गई है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is correct because the 30 KTPA green hydrogen production capacity was awarded under the SIGHT (Strategic Interventions for Green Hydrogen Transition) Mode - 2B scheme of the National Green Hydrogen Mission.
• Other options are incorrect as they do not correspond to the specific scheme mentioned in the government notification.

national_questions.qe: In which city was the Fourth Session of the India-Namibia Joint Trade Committee (JTC) held to discuss bilateral trade diversification?
national_questions.qh: द्विपक्षीय व्यापार विविधीकरण पर चर्चा करने के लिए भारत-नामीबिया संयुक्त व्यापार समिति (JTC) का चौथा सत्र किस शहर में आयोजित किया गया था?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is correct because the Fourth Session of the India-Namibia Joint Trade Committee (JTC) was held in New Delhi, where both nations agreed to move beyond raw-material-based trade.
• Other options are incorrect as they were not the venue for this specific diplomatic trade session.

national_questions.qe: Who has been selected as the Vice-Chancellor of the Atal Bihari Vajpayee Institute of Public Service and Innovation (AIPSI) in Mauritius?
national_questions.qh: मॉरीशस में अटल बिहारी वाजपेयी इंस्टीट्यूट ऑफ पब्लिक सर्विस एंड इनोवेशन (AIPSI) के कुलपति के रूप में किसे चुना गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is correct because Dr. Bhooma VG (IRPS Retd.) was selected for the post of Vice-Chancellor at AIPSI, an institute inaugurated by the PMs of India and Mauritius in March 2025.
• Other options are incorrect as they are not associated with this specific appointment.

national_questions.qe: Which Indian revolutionary freedom fighter was executed by the British in 1908 at the young age of 18 following the Muzaffarpur Bomb Case?
national_questions.qh: वर्ष 1908 में मुजफ्फरपुर बम कांड के बाद किस भारतीय क्रांतिकारी स्वतंत्रता सेनानी को मात्र 18 वर्ष की आयु में अंग्रेजों द्वारा फांसी दी गई थी?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because Khudiram Bose, along with Prafulla Chaki, was involved in the Muzaffarpur Bomb Case (1908) targeting British magistrate Douglas Kingsford. Bose was arrested and executed on August 11, 1908, becoming one of the youngest martyrs of the Indian freedom struggle.
• Option A is Incorrect because Prafulla Chaki shot himself to avoid arrest during the same incident.
• Option B is Incorrect because Batukeshwar Dutt was associated with the 1929 Central Assembly bombing alongside Bhagat Singh.
• Option D is Incorrect because Madan Lal Dhingra assassinated Curzon Wyllie in London in 1909.

national_questions.qe: Which state became the first in India to deploy National Common Mobility Card (NCMC) RuPay smartcards for concessional passengers in its state transport service?
national_questions.qh: अपनी राज्य परिवहन सेवा में रियायती यात्रियों के लिए नेशनल कॉमन मोबिलिटी कार्ड (NCMC) रुपे स्मार्टकार्ड लागू करने वाला भारत का पहला राज्य कौन सा बना है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because Maharashtra (MSRTC) became the first state transport corporation in India to issue and accept NCMC RuPay smartcards for concessional passengers, replacing traditional paper passes.
• Option B is Incorrect because Gujarat has not implemented NCMC specifically for state transport concessional passes.
• Option C is Incorrect because Karnataka uses digital passes but has not spearheaded NCMC integration for state bus concessional passengers.
• Option D is Incorrect because Tamil Nadu state transport services have not yet integrated NCMC smartcards for concessional travel.

national_questions.qe: What is the name of India's first mini electric vertical takeoff and landing (VTOL) passenger aircraft series being developed by aerospace startup AlphaX Aerospace?
national_questions.qh: एरोस्पेस स्टार्टअप अल्फाएक्स एरोस्पेस द्वारा विकसित की जा रही भारत की पहली मिनी इलेक्ट्रिक वर्टिकल टेकऑफ़ एंड लैंडिंग (VTOL) यात्री विमान श्रृंखला का नाम क्या है?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because SkyRover is India's first mini electric passenger aircraft series developed by Karnataka-based startup AlphaX Aerospace, featuring VTOL capabilities with an 800 km range.
• Option A is Incorrect because AeroGlide is a generic terms and not the name of this specific aircraft series.
• Option B is Incorrect because SkyFlyer is not the designated name of AlphaX Aerospace's electric aircraft series.
• Option C is Incorrect because VayuX is a fictitious option name.

national_questions.qe: Which High Court established India's first landmark judicial framework on copyright infringement and generative AI in the case of ANI Media Pvt. Ltd. v. OpenAI?
national_questions.qh: एएनआई मीडिया प्राइवेट लिमिटेड बनाम ओपनएआई (ANI Media Pvt. Ltd. v. OpenAI) मामले में कॉपीराइट उल्लंघन और जनरेटिव एआई पर भारत का पहला ऐतिहासिक न्यायिक ढांचा किस उच्च न्यायालय ने स्थापित किया?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the Delhi High Court delivered India's first judicial framework addressing copyright issues and territorial jurisdiction concerning generative AI models in ANI Media Pvt. Ltd. v. OpenAI OpCo LLC.
• Option A is Incorrect because the Bombay High Court was not the forum for this landmark generative AI ruling.
• Option C is Incorrect because the Madras High Court did not issue this legal precedent.
• Option D is Incorrect because the Karnataka High Court was not involved in this legal matter.

national_questions.qe: India's first immersive language museum, named 'Shabdalok', showcasing 22 constitutionally recognized languages, has been established at which historic location?
national_questions.qh: 22 संविधान द्वारा मान्यता प्राप्त भाषाओं को प्रदर्शित करने वाला भारत का पहला इमर्सिव भाषा संग्रहालय, 'शब्दलोक', किस ऐतिहासिक स्थान पर स्थापित किया गया है?
oe: National Council of Science Museums, Kolkata
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct: 'Shabdalok', India's first immersive language museum, has been opened by the National Library at the historic Belvedere House campus in Kolkata. It features nine specialized galleries dedicated to the evolution of words in India's 22 Eighth Schedule languages.
• Option A is Incorrect: The Asiatic Society is an institution dedicated to Oriental research but is not the location of Shabdalok.
• Option C is Incorrect: Victoria Memorial Hall is a major historical museum in Kolkata but not the site for this language museum.
• Option D is Incorrect: NCSM manages science centers across India, whereas Shabdalok is set up under the aegis of the National Library.

national_questions.qe: Which agency is responsible for executing India's first high-speed rail corridor project between Mumbai and Ahmedabad?
national_questions.qh: मुंबई और अहमदाबाद के बीच भारत की पहली हाई-स्पीड रेल कॉरिडोर परियोजना को लागू करने के लिए कौन सी संस्था जिम्मेदार है?
oe: Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited (DFCCIL)
National High Speed Rail Corporation Limited (NHSRCL)
oh: डेडिकेटेड फ्रेट कॉरिडोर कॉर्पोरेशन ऑफ इंडिया लिमिटेड (DFCCIL)
नेशनल हाई स्पीड रेल कॉर्पोरेशन लिमिटेड (NHSRCL)
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct: The 508 km Mumbai–Ahmedabad High-Speed Rail Corridor is being executed by the National High Speed Rail Corporation Limited (NHSRCL), a Special Purpose Vehicle formed to finance, construct, and operate high-speed rail routes.
• Option A is Incorrect: DFCCIL is mandated specifically for constructing dedicated freight rail corridors.
• Option B is Incorrect: RVNL carries out general railway infrastructure augmentation project development.
• Option C is Incorrect: IRCON focuses on specialized engineering and construction projects in India and abroad.

national_questions.qe: India launched its first-ever national 'Guide to Grasslands and Other Open Natural Ecosystems (ONEs)' during which international conference?
national_questions.qh: भारत ने किस अंतर्राष्ट्रीय सम्मेलन के दौरान 'घास के मैदानों और अन्य खुले प्राकृतिक पारिस्थितिक तंत्रों (ONEs) के लिए मार्गदर्शिका' का पहला राष्ट्रीय संस्करण लॉन्च किया?
oh: यूएनएफसीसीसी (UNFCCC) COP28, दुबई, संयुक्त अरब अमीरात
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct: India introduced its first national Guide to Grasslands and Other Open Natural Ecosystems (ONEs) at COP17 of the United Nations Convention to Combat Desertification (UNCCD) in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia. It aligns with the Wildlife Protection Act (1972) and National Biodiversity Action Plan.
• Option B is Incorrect: UNFCCC COP28 focused primarily on global climate change negotiations and emission commitments.
• Option C is Incorrect: CBD COP16 addressed global biodiversity targets but was not the platform where this guide was launched.
• Option D is Incorrect: Ramsar COP14 concentrated specifically on wetland preservation.

national_questions.qe: India's first dedicated maintenance depot for Vande Bharat sleeper trains is being developed at which railway division location?
national_questions.qh: वंदे भारत स्लीपर ट्रेनों के लिए भारत का पहला समर्पित रखरखाव डिपो किस रेलवे मंडल स्थान पर विकसित किया जा रहा है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct: Indian Railways is setting up the country's first Vande Bharat sleeper train maintenance depot in Jodhpur, Rajasthan (North Western Railway Zone), in partnership with a Russian joint venture partner.
• Option A is Incorrect: Ahmedabad is connected to the Vande Bharat network but is not the host of this flagship sleeper depot.
• Option B is Incorrect: Jaipur is served by North Western Railway but the dedicated sleeper maintenance facility is located in Jodhpur.
• Option D is Incorrect: Secunderabad is a major South Central Railway hub but does not house this initial sleeper depot.

national_questions.qe: Which state has announced the establishment of India's first government-owned Artificial Intelligence (AI) University alongside introducing AI education in schools from Class 6?
national_questions.qh: किस राज्य ने कक्षा 6 से स्कूलों में एआई शिक्षा शुरू करने के साथ-साथ भारत का पहला सरकारी स्वामित्व वाला कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता (AI) विश्वविद्यालय स्थापित करने की घोषणा की है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct: Karnataka announced the establishment of India's first government-owned AI University in Bengaluru, along with introducing AI education from Class 6 under the 'AI Akshara Abhiyana' and 'Coding Gurukula' initiatives.
• Option A is Incorrect: Telangana launched an AI-based hospital pneumatic system, not the first public AI university.
• Option C is Incorrect: Tamil Nadu has digital education programmes but is not setting up India's first public AI university.
• Option D is Incorrect: Maharashtra has tech hubs but has not announced this specific public AI university.

national_questions.qe: Dr. Marri Chenna Reddy TIMS, which became India's first government hospital to install an AI-based pneumatic tube system for fast medical sample transport, is located in which state?
national_questions.qh: डॉ. मरि चेन्ना रेड्डी टिम्स (TIMS), जो त्वरित चिकित्सा नमूना परिवहन के लिए एआई-आधारित न्यूमैटिक ट्यूब सिस्टम स्थापित करने वाला भारत का पहला सरकारी अस्पताल बन गया है, किस राज्य में स्थित है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct: Dr. Marri Chenna Reddy TIMS is located in Telangana. It is India's first government hospital equipped with an AI-based pneumatic tube system that transports blood samples and lab reports across departments in 1 to 2 minutes.
• Option B is Incorrect: Kerala was not the location for this healthcare infrastructure project.
• Option C is Incorrect: Gujarat is known for telehealth initiatives but not this specific AI pneumatic tube installation.
• Option D is Incorrect: Andhra Pradesh is a neighboring state but does not house TIMS.

national_questions.qe: India's first Sports Artificial Intelligence (AI) Centre for athlete performance evaluation and early talent identification has been inaugurated at which premier institution?
national_questions.qh: एथलीटों के प्रदर्शन मूल्यांकन और प्रारंभिक प्रतिभा पहचान के लिए भारत का पहला 'स्पोर्ट्स एआई सेंटर' किस प्रमुख संस्थान में शुरू किया गया है?
oe: Netaji Subhas National Institute of Sports, Patiala
Indira Gandhi Institute of Physical Education, New Delhi
Lakshmibai National Institute of Physical Education, Gwalior
Sports Authority of India Regional Centre, Bengaluru
oh: नेताजी सुभाष राष्ट्रीय खेल संस्थान, पटियाला
इंदिरा गांधी शारीरिक शिक्षा संस्थान, नई दिल्ली
लक्ष्मीबाई राष्ट्रीय शारीरिक शिक्षा संस्थान, ग्वालियर
भारतीय खेल प्राधिकरण क्षेत्रीय केंद्र, बेंगलुरु
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct: India's first Sports AI Centre was inaugurated at Lakshmibai National Institute of Physical Education (LNIPE) in Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh, to optimize training and athletic talent analysis.
• Option A is Incorrect: NSNIS Patiala is a premier coaching institute, but the Sports AI Centre was established at LNIPE Gwalior.
• Option B is Incorrect: IGIPESS is located in New Delhi and is not the host of this new centre.
• Option D is Incorrect: SAI Bengaluru is a major training hub but did not launch this specific AI centre.

national_questions.qe: Which state became the first in India to deploy QR codes outside hotels and commercial food establishments to allow citizens to lodge real-time food safety complaints?
national_questions.qh: नागरिकों को वास्तविक समय में खाद्य सुरक्षा शिकायत दर्ज करने की सुविधा देने के लिए होटलों और वाणिज्यिक खाद्य प्रतिष्ठानों के बाहर क्यूआर कोड तैनात करने वाला भारत का पहला राज्य कौन सा बना है?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct: Karnataka became the first Indian state to introduce a QR code-based system outside food establishments and pharmacies, enabling real-time complaints directly to food safety officers.
• Option A is Incorrect: Rajasthan has implemented digital governance models, but not this QR food safety system.
• Option B is Incorrect: Madhya Pradesh launched a virtual zoo recently, not the QR food complaint mechanism.
• Option C is Incorrect: Tamil Nadu enforces FSSAI regulations strictly but was not the first to implement this specific QR complaint system.

national_questions.qe: Which manufacturing unit of Indian Railways has developed India's first Vande Bharat freight train?
national_questions.qh: भारतीय रेलवे की किस विनिर्माण इकाई ने भारत की पहली वंदे भारत फ्रेट (मालगाड़ी) ट्रेन विकसित की है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct: India's first Vande Bharat freight train was manufactured at the Integral Coach Factory (ICF) in Chennai. It features a maximum operational speed of 160 kmph, a payload capacity of 395 tonnes, automatic sliding doors, and the indigenous KAVACH anti-collision system.
• Option A is Incorrect: Rail Coach Factory (RCF) Kapurthala manufactures standard passenger coaches and Linke Hofmann Busch (LHB) coaches.
• Option C is Incorrect: Modern Coach Factory (MCF) Raebareli produces LHB passenger coaches.
• Option D is Incorrect: Chittaranjan Locomotive Works (CLW) primarily produces electric locomotives.

national_questions.qe: In which Union Territory is India's first island-based geothermal power project being developed by the Solar Energy Corporation of India (SECI)?
national_questions.qh: भारतीय सौर ऊर्जा निगम (SECI) द्वारा भारत की पहली द्वीप-आधारित भू-तापीय ऊर्जा परियोजना किस केंद्र शासित प्रदेश में विकसित की जा रही है?
oe: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
oh: दादरा और नगर हवेली तथा दमन और दीव
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct: The Solar Energy Corporation of India (SECI) Ltd has initiated the process to develop India's first geothermal power project in an island region in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands to reduce dependence on diesel generation and improve long-term clean energy security.
• Option A is Incorrect: Lakshadweep relies primarily on solar-diesel hybrid solutions and does not host this geothermal initiative.
• Option B is Incorrect: Puducherry is a coastal mainland union territory with grid connectivity.
• Option D is Incorrect: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu are mainland western UTs powered via regional electrical grids.

national_questions.qe: Which 140-year-old structure in Jhansi, Uttar Pradesh, was recently recognized as a World Heritage Irrigation Structure (WHIS) by the International Commission on Irrigation and Drainage (ICID)?
national_questions.qh: उत्तर प्रदेश के झांसी में स्थित किस 140 वर्ष पुराने ढांचे को हाल ही में इंटरनेशनल कमीशन ऑन इरिगेशन एंड ड्रेनेज (ICID) द्वारा विश्व विरासत सिंचाई संरचना (WHIS) के रूप में मान्यता दी गई है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct: The 140-year-old Parichha Weir across the Betwa River in Jhansi, Uttar Pradesh, received World Heritage Irrigation Structure (WHIS) status from the International Commission on Irrigation and Drainage (ICID).
• Option B is Incorrect: Kanpur Barrage (Ganga Barrage) is a modern structure on the Ganges built in the late 1990s.
• Option C is Incorrect: Narora Barrage is situated on the Ganga in Bulandshahr district, UP.
• Option D is Incorrect: Hathnikund Barrage is located on the Yamuna river in Haryana.

national_questions.qe: India's first eco-educational hub named 'Prakriti Gyan Dham' has been established by which constituent laboratory of CSIR?
national_questions.qh: भारत का पहला पर्यावरण-शिक्षा केंद्र 'प्रकृति ज्ञान धाम' CSIR की किस घटक प्रयोगशाला द्वारा स्थापित किया गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct: 'Prakriti Gyan Dham', India's first open-air eco-educational hub, was created by CSIR-National Botanical Research Institute (CSIR-NBRI) at its Maharishi Parashar Bioresource Centre in Banthra, Lucknow, UP.
• Option A is Incorrect: CSIR-CDRI focuses on pharmaceutical and drug development research in Lucknow.
• Option B is Incorrect: CSIR-NEERI is located in Nagpur and deals with environmental engineering solutions.
• Option C is Incorrect: CSIR-IIP is based in Dehradun, specializing in petroleum and bio-fuels research.

national_questions.qe: Which public procurement platform introduced 'GeMAI', India's first generative-AI powered system for intelligent government procurement?
national_questions.qh: किस सार्वजनिक खरीद मंच ने भारत की पहली जनरेटिव-एआई संचालित प्रणाली 'GeMAI' की शुरुआत की है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because Government e-Marketplace (GeM) launched GeMAI, India's first generative-AI powered government e-marketplace system to facilitate intelligent procurement.
• Option B is Incorrect because CPPP is the central government portal for public tenders but is not the developer of GeMAI.
• Option C is Incorrect because e-NAM is an online trading network for agricultural commodities under the Ministry of Agriculture.
• Option D is Incorrect because NSWS is a digital portal for investors to obtain business clearances and approvals.

national_questions.qe: Which major port in India became the country's first major port to achieve Scope-2 Emission-Free status?
national_questions.qh: भारत का कौन सा प्रमुख बंदरगाह 'स्कोप-2 उत्सर्जन-मुक्त' (Scope-2 Emission-Free) दर्जा प्राप्त करने वाला देश का पहला प्रमुख बंदरगाह बन गया है?
oe: Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port, West Bengal
oh: श्यामा प्रसाद मुखर्जी पोर्ट, पश्चिम बंगाल
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because V.O.C. Port in Thoothukudi, Tamil Nadu, became India's first major port to achieve Scope-2 Emission-Free status, powered by 7.04 MW solar and 2 MW wind capacity.
• Option A is Incorrect because Jawaharlal Nehru Port (JNPT) is a major container port in Maharashtra but did not achieve this specific emission certification.
• Option C is Incorrect because Deendayal Port (Kandla) is located in Gujarat.
• Option D is Incorrect because Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port is a riverine port located in West Bengal.

national_questions.qe: Which of the following were India's first experimental remote sensing satellites, launched aboard Soviet Intercosmos rockets between 1979 and 1981?
national_questions.qh: निम्नलिखित में से 1979 और 1981 के बीच सोवियत इंटरकॉसमॉस रॉकेटों द्वारा प्रक्षेपित भारत के पहले प्रायोगिक सुदूर संवेदन (रिमोट सेंसिंग) उपग्रह कौन से थे?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because Bhaskara-I and Bhaskara-II (1979-1981) were India's first experimental remote sensing satellites, equipped with TV cameras and Microwave Radiometers (SAMIR).
• Option A is Incorrect because Aryabhata (1975) was India's first satellite overall, focused on space physics and astronomy rather than remote sensing.
• Option B is Incorrect because the Rohini series comprised experimental payloads launched by India's SLV-3 rocket.
• Option D is Incorrect because IRS-1A (1988) and IRS-1B (1991) were India's first operational remote sensing satellites.

national_questions.qe: Which state has become the first in India to issue National Common Mobility Card (NCMC) smartcards to state transport concession passengers across its road transport network?
national_questions.qh: अपने राज्य परिवहन नेटवर्क में छूट पाने वाले यात्रियों के लिए 'नेशनल कॉमन मोबिलिटी कार्ड' (NCMC) स्मार्टकार्ड जारी करने वाला भारत का पहला राज्य कौन सा बन गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because Maharashtra State Road Transport Corporation (MSRTC) became the first state transport undertaking in India to deploy National Common Mobility Cards (NCMC) for concession passengers, covering over 16,000 villages.
• Option B is Incorrect because Gujarat has introduced NCMC on select metro lines but not as a statewide concession integration for road transport.
• Option C is Incorrect because Karnataka operates NCMC on Namma Metro and select bus routes, but not as the pioneer for state transport concession passes.
• Option D is Incorrect because Tamil Nadu is piloting common ticketing solutions, not nationwide concession NCMC smartcards.

national_questions.qe: Which Union Ministry is the nodal agency for implementing the Electronics Component Manufacturing Scheme (ECMS) to promote domestic production of critical electronic components?
national_questions.qh: महत्वपूर्ण इलेक्ट्रॉनिक घटकों के घरेलू उत्पादन को बढ़ावा देने के लिए 'इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स घटक निर्माण योजना' (ECMS) को लागू करने वाला नोडल केंद्रीय मंत्रालय कौन सा है?
oe: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) implements the Electronics Component Manufacturing Scheme (ECMS) to boost domestic manufacturing of components like filters, coils, and electrolyte additives.
• Option A is Incorrect because the Ministry of Heavy Industries focuses on automotive and heavy capital goods sectors.
• Option C is Incorrect because the Ministry of Commerce and Industry manages trade policies and foreign investment, not ECMS directly.
• Option D is Incorrect because the Ministry of Science and Technology oversees scientific research rather than component manufacturing schemes.

national_questions.qe: In which city has India's first virtual zoo, featuring a 14D immersive cinema and digital jungle safari, been established at the Kamala Nehru Prani Sangrahalaya?
national_questions.qh: कमला नेहरू प्राणी संग्रहालय में 14D इमर्सिव सिनेमा और डिजिटल जंगल सफारी की सुविधा वाला भारत का पहला वर्चुअल चिड़ियाघर किस शहर में स्थापित किया गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because India's first virtual zoo was established at the Kamala Nehru Prani Sangrahalaya in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, developed under a Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model.
• Option A is Incorrect because Bhopal houses Van Vihar National Park, not India's first 14D virtual zoo.
• Option B is Incorrect because Jaipur features the Nahargarh Biological Park, but not the digital 14D virtual zoo facility.
• Option D is Incorrect because Nagpur houses the Maharajbagh Zoo, but not this immersive 14D digital project.

national_questions.qe: In which city is India's first government-owned Artificial Intelligence (AI) University being established?
national_questions.qh: भारत का पहला सरकारी स्वामित्व वाला आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस (AI) विश्वविद्यालय किस शहर में स्थापित किया जा रहा है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because India's first government-owned AI University is being established in Bengaluru by the Karnataka State Government.
• Option A is Incorrect because Hyderabad is not the designated location for this landmark state-owned AI university.
• Option C is Incorrect because Pune was not chosen for setting up this state-backed institution.
• Option D is Incorrect because Noida is not associated with this initiative.

national_questions.qe: Which facility developed India's first Vande Bharat freight train, which successfully underwent high-speed trial runs on the West Central Railway?
national_questions.qh: पश्चिम मध्य रेलवे पर उच्च गति परीक्षण पूरा करने वाली भारत की पहली वंदे भारत मालगाड़ी (Freight Train) का निर्माण किस इकाई द्वारा किया गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because India's first Vande Bharat freight train was developed and manufactured by the Integral Coach Factory (ICF), Chennai, and achieved 130 kmph during trials on the Kota-Rohal Khurd section.
• Option A is Incorrect because Modern Coach Factory, Raebareli was not the developer of this freight trainset.
• Option B is Incorrect because Rail Coach Factory, Kapurthala produces conventional and LHB passenger coaches.
• Option D is Incorrect because Chittaranjan Locomotive Works focuses on building electric locomotives rather than self-propelled freight trainsets.

national_questions.qe: Which state has announced the integration of drones, satellite imagery, and artificial intelligence into its Sadak Surakhya Force to create India's first 3D policing model?
national_questions.qh: किस राज्य ने अपनी 'सड़क सुरक्षा बल' में ड्रोन, सैटेलाइट इमेजरी और आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस को एकीकृत करके भारत का पहला 3D पुलिसिंग मॉडल विकसित करने की घोषणा की है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the Punjab Police's Sadak Surakhya Force (SSF) is set to become India's first 3D policing model, leveraging drones, satellite data, and AI-powered predictive systems to enhance road safety and situational awareness.
• Option B is Incorrect because Haryana has not initiated this 3D policing model.
• Option C is Incorrect because Rajasthan operates standard highway police units without this specific 3D model integration.
• Option D is Incorrect because Uttar Pradesh is not the state launching this Sadak Surakhya Force 3D policing initiative.

national_questions.qe: Which Hyderabad-based space technology company developed 'Vikram-1', India's first privately developed orbital rocket?
national_questions.qh: भारत का पहला निजी तौर पर विकसित ऑर्बिटल रॉकेट 'विक्रम-1' हैदराबाद स्थित किस स्पेस टेक्नोलॉजी कंपनी द्वारा विकसित किया गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because Vikram-1, India's first privately developed orbital launch vehicle, was created by Skyroot Aerospace, a Hyderabad-based space company.
• Option A is Incorrect because Agnikul Cosmos is a Chennai-based startup known for its Agnibaan rocket powered by a 3D-printed engine.
• Option C is Incorrect because Bellatrix Aerospace specializes in satellite propulsion systems and orbital transfer vehicles.
• Option D is Incorrect because Dhruva Space focuses on full-stack small satellite platforms and satellite deployers.

bihar_questions.qe: Which National Highway section in Bihar is being upgraded to a four-lane standard under the Hybrid Annuity Mode to serve as a key feeder corridor connecting the India-Nepal border at Sonbarsa with Muzaffarpur?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार में भारत-नेपाल सीमा पर स्थित सोनबरसा को मुजफ्फरपुर से जोड़ने वाले किस राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग खंड को हाइब्रिड एनिओटी मोड (HAM) के तहत चार लेन में उन्नत करने की मंजूरी दी गई है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA) approved the four-laning of the 82.58-km Muzaffarpur-Sitamarhi-Sonbarsa section of NH-22 in Bihar at a capital cost of Rs 3,590.73 crore under the Hybrid Annuity Mode (HAM).
• Option B is Incorrect because NH-27 forms part of the East-West Corridor, to which NH-22 serves as an important feeder route.
• Option C is Incorrect because NH-31 is a major highway traversing East-West Bihar along the Ganga river.
• Option D is Incorrect because NH-106 connects Bihpur to Madhepura and Birpur in northern Bihar.

bihar_questions.qe: Under the Kosi-Mechi Inter-State River Link Project in Bihar, surplus water from the Kosi River will be diverted into the Mechi River to primarily enhance water availability in which river basin?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार में कोसी-मेची अंतर-राज्यीय नदी जोड़ो परियोजना के तहत, कोसी नदी के अधिशेष पानी को किस नदी बेसिन में जल उपलब्धता बढ़ाने के लिए मेची नदी में स्थानांतरित किया जाएगा?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Rs 6,282.32-crore Kosi-Mechi River Link Project transfers excess water from the Kosi River via a link canal to the Mechi River (a tributary of Mahananda), thereby augmenting water availability in the Mahananda basin and irrigating over 2.14 lakh hectares in Seemanchal.
• Option A is Incorrect because the Gandak Basin lies in north-western Bihar, whereas Kosi-Mechi operates in the north-eastern region.
• Option B is Incorrect because Burhi Gandak flows central to North Bihar, distinct from the eastern Seemanchal border area.
• Option D is Incorrect because the Sone River basin is located south of the Ganga River.

bihar_questions.qe: Under which section of the Representation of the People Act, 1950, read with Article 324 of the Constitution, is the Election Commission of India empowered to conduct a Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls?
bihar_questions.qh: भारतीय संविधान के अनुच्छेद 324 के साथ लोक प्रतिनिधित्व अधिनियम, 1950 की किस धारा के तहत भारत निर्वाचन आयोग को मतदाता सूचियों के विशेष गहन पुनरीक्षण (SIR) का वैधानिक अधिकार प्राप्त है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because Section 21(3) of the Representation of the People Act, 1950, along with Article 324 of the Constitution, provides statutory power to the Election Commission of India to order a special revision of electoral rolls for any constituency or part thereof.
• Option A is Incorrect because Section 12 deals with administrative qualifications and registration provisions.
• Option C is Incorrect because Section 29A deals with the registration of political parties with the Election Commission.
• Option D is Incorrect because Section 123 belongs to the Representation of the People Act, 1951, defining corrupt practices during elections.

bihar_questions.qe: Under which central scheme has the Patna Metro received Rs 628.32 crore funding?
bihar_questions.qh: पटनामेट्रो को किस केंद्रीय योजना के तहत ₹ 628.32 करोड़ की फंडिंग मिली है?

oh: अटल मिशन फॉर रेजुवेनेशन एंड अर्बन ट्रांसफ़ॉर्मेशन (अमरुत)
bihar_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the Patna Metro project was granted Rs 628.32 crore under the Central Capital Investment Scheme, a flagship funding programme of the Union Government for metro and rail‑based urban transport.
• Option A is Incorrect; the Gram Sadak Yojana funds rural road construction, not metro projects.
• Option C is Incorrect; Smart Cities Mission supports broader urban development but not direct metro capital grants.
• Option D is Incorrect; AMRUT focuses on water supply, sewerage and urban infrastructure, not metro financing.

bihar_questions.qe: The Kosi‑Mechi inter‑state river link project primarily aims to boost irrigation in which region of Bihar?
bihar_questions.qh: कोसी‑मेची अंतरराज्यीय जल लिंक परियोजना मुख्यतः बिहार के किस क्षेत्र में सिंचाई को बढ़ाने के लिए है?

bihar_questions.qe: How many coal blocks does the Bihar government plan to allocate from the surveyed 44 blocks?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार सरकार 44 सर्वे किए गए कोयला ब्लॉकों में से कितने ब्लॉकों को आवंटित करने की योजना बना रही है?

bihar_questions.qe: What is the total length of the newly sanctioned Sherghati‑Kajree Broad Gauge railway line?

bihar_questions.qh: बिहार सरकार ने राज्य में खनन कार्यों के पुनः प्रारम्भ की घोषणा किस तिथि को की?

bihar_questions.qe: Which central scheme has Bihar joined for the first time to procure pulses directly from farmers?
bihar_questions.qh: किस केंद्रीय योजना में बिहार ने पहली बार किसानों से सीधे दालें खरीदने के लिए भाग लिया?

bihar_questions.qe: By what year is the road and water infrastructure for the Gaya Integrated Manufacturing Cluster (IMC) expected to be completed?
bihar_questions.qh: गया इंटीग्रेटेड मैन्युफैक्चरिंग क्लस्टर (IMC) की सड़क और जल बुनियादी ढाँचा किस वर्ष तक पूरा होने की उम्मीद है?

bihar_questions.qe: What is the investment target announced by the Bihar government to be achieved by November?

bihar_questions.qe: What is the total length of the proposed Sherghati‑Kajree broad‑gauge railway line?
bihar_questions.qh: शेर्घाटी‑कजरी ब्रॉड‑गेज रेलवे लाइन की कुल लंबाई कितनी है?

bihar_questions.qe: What total investment amount has Bihar set as its target to be achieved by November under the new industrial and education policies?

bihar_questions.qe: What is the sanctioned cost of the 107.89‑km Sherghati‑Kajree broad‑gauge railway line approved by the Railway Ministry?
bihar_questions.qh: रेलवे मंत्रालय द्वारा स्वीकृत 107.89 किमी शेरघाटी‑कजरी ब्रॉड‑गेज रेलवे लाइन की स्वीकृत लागत क्या है?

bihar_questions.qe: The 7.7 MW solar power plant commissioned in Gaya is under which central scheme?
